continuity: The Lord has advised Ma Junggeol and his sworn brothers for more than ten years, including encouraging them to form Baekma Bang and explore a western trade route.
At Taekyung’s order, six of the Seven Masters leave to bring the Lord back within five days of the march’s halt; Ma Junggeol remains with Taekyung’s group.
Namho says he has an important matter he can only disclose to Taekyung now.
plot: Taekyung challenges Ma Junggeol and the Seven Masters of Baekma Bang over their unexplained knowledge and the Lord’s possible connection to the crisis. Ma admits the Lord has advised them for more than ten years, helped them form Baekma Bang, encouraged their search for a western trade route, and urged them to seek Taekyung’s group. Taekyung sends six of the Seven Masters to fetch the Lord within five days, while Ma stays behind. Namho then says he has something important he can only tell Taekyung now.
translation_decisions: Render 칠주야 as “seven days and nights”; Taekyung sets a five-day deadline for the Lord’s return.
